title: Add mouse movement, pathfinding, and collision
goal: Study original client/server movement and hit-map logic so clicking the map routes the character around blocked cells, while WASD and mouse movement both obey impassable terrain and warp/event tiles.
source: external/sources/client-source/system/map.cpp, mouse.cpp, pc.cpp; external/sources/gmsv/map/readmap.c, char/char_walk.c; public/data/maps/*.ls2map and public/data/client-maps/*.dat
acceptance: Map collision/hit data is derived from tile/parts/event layers and original hit rules
WASD movement rejects blocked cells instead of walking through walls/objects
Clicking a reachable tile creates and follows a route in isometric directions
Clicking an unreachable/blocked tile gives no invalid movement and does not desync the save
Pathing cooperates with warp tiles, NPC/action hotspots, and camera centering
Browser playtest covers obstacles in 萨姆吉尔村 and at least one large outdoor map
notes: Started 2026-05-12. Worker movement now builds cached hit maps from DAT/LS2MAP tile, parts, and event layers using client adrn hit metadata; WASD/API movement blocks terrain and NPC cells while preserving warp tiles. Map clicks now convert canvas coordinates to map cells, ask the Worker for a bounded validated route, and follow it step by step. Exit buttons now use Worker `/api/game/route-exit` to choose a reachable exact source warp tile, letting `/walk` trigger mapwarp instead of instant `/travel` or client-side tile guessing. NPC marker/list clicks now use Worker `/api/game/route-npc` to pick a reachable nearby interaction tile before opening dialogue. Next: richer original-client turn/route batching and click affordances.
